sentence_patterns.explanation: Used to express a direct personal desire or intention.
sentence_patterns.hindi_formula: मैं + [verb root] + ना चाहता हूँ / चाहती हूँ

examples.english: I want to talk to you.
examples.hindi: मैं तुमसे बात करना चाहता हूँ।

sentence_patterns.practice_prompt: Try building: 'I want to drink water.'

sentence_patterns.explanation: Polite request to ask someone to do an action.
sentence_patterns.hindi_formula: क्या आप कृपया + [verb] + कर सकते हैं?

examples.hindi: क्या आप कृपया मुझे कॉल कर सकते हैं?

examples.english: Can you please send the details?
examples.hindi: क्या आप कृपया डिटेल्स भेज सकते हैं?

examples.english: Can you please wait for 5 minutes?
examples.hindi: क्या आप कृपया 5 मिनट इंतज़ार कर सकते हैं?

sentence_patterns.practice_prompt: Try building: 'Can you please help me?'

sentence_patterns.explanation: Present perfect continuous: actions that started in the past and continue into the present moment.

examples.english: I have been working here for two years.
examples.hindi: मैं यहाँ दो साल से काम कर रहा हूँ।
examples.telugu: నేను ఇక్కడ రెండు సంవత్సరాల నుండి పనిచేస్తున్నాను.

examples.english: I have been waiting for 30 minutes.
examples.hindi: मैं 30 मिनट से इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ।

sentence_patterns.practice_prompt: Try building: 'I have been studying since morning.'

sentence_patterns.explanation: Checking readiness for an upcoming action.
sentence_patterns.hindi_formula: क्या तुम + [verb] + करने के लिए तैयार हो?

examples.hindi: क्या तुम निकलने के लिए तैयार हो?

examples.english: Are you ready to join the meeting?
examples.hindi: क्या तुम मीटिंग जॉइन करने के लिए तैयार हो?

sentence_patterns.practice_prompt: Try building: 'Are you ready to eat?'
